product_in_use: A small pack of milk is handled the way people really handle one: carried at the side, handed over, tucked into a crate, set down on a counter, poured from its opened corner into a glass or a vessel. Never held out at arm's length toward the camera, and never left alone as a centrepiece with no one touching it, because both read as an advertising hero shot and make the pack render oversized.
must_show: enough visible milk in any glass (liquid, a film on the sides, a ring at the base) for it to read as a milk glass in a photograph, whether the glass is full, half or already drained
a pour seen clearly: milk visibly streaming from the pack's opened corner
the pack's front label toward the camera as far as the action allows, and only one pack in the image
pack_in_scene: only when it is in use
imagery_style: photorealistic food and lifestyle photography: full-frame DSLR look, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, warm natural light; illustration, when used, carries a warm storybook or folk-art feel in the brand palette
people_setting: An authentic family setting: a family in a warm home, a mother and children at the table, shopkeepers at a neighbourhood shop, real locations in natural light, premium and wholesome.
sound_world: Warm, wholesome and uplifting. Gentle instrumentation (warm strings, a solo bansuri flute over a soft tanpura drone, light tabla), no vocals and no lyrics. A warm female voice, Telugu-accented English by default.
